function tuple(f: ((...args: [string, number]) => void) | ((...args: [string, boolean]) => void)) {
  f();
  f('one');
  f('two', 3);
  f('two', true);
  f('three', 3, 4);
}
function one(f: ((...args: [number]) => void) | ((...args: [string]) => void)) {
  f();
  f(1);
  f('a');
}
function mixed(f: ((...args: [string, number]) => void) | ((x: string, y: boolean) => void)) {
  f();
  f('one');
  f('two', 3);
}
function required(f: ((prefix: string, ...args: [number]) => void) | ((prefix: string, ...args: [boolean]) => void)) {
  f();
  f('one');
  f('two', 3);
}
function variadic(f: ((...args: [string, number, ...boolean[]]) => void) | ((...args: [string, string, ...number[]]) => void)) {
  f();
  f('one');
  f('two', 3);
  f('three', 'a', true);
}
function trailing(f: ((...args: [string, ...number[], boolean]) => void) | ((...args: [string, ...boolean[], number]) => void)) {
  f();
  f('one');
  f('two', 3);
  f('two', true);
  f('three', true, 3);
  f('bad', 'a');
}
function shaped(f: ((...args: [string, number?]) => void) | ((...args: [string, boolean?]) => void)) {
  f();
  f('one');
  f('two', undefined);
}
function defaults(f: ((x: number | void, ...args: [number]) => void) | ((x: number | void, ...args: [string]) => void)) {
  f();
  f(1);
  f(undefined);
  f(1, 1);
}
